description: This is the main application component for a React-based to-do list application. It manages navigation between 'All Tasks' and 'Completed Tasks' pages using a bottom navigation bar and renders the appropriate page component based on the current state.

methods.name: App()
methods.description: Main functional React component that manages task view navigation state and renders either TodoPage or CompletedTasksPage based on the current selected page.

methods.name: handleNavSelect
methods.description: Event handler that updates the current page state based on user navigation selection.

methods.name: NavBarImpl
methods.description: Wrapper component for NavigationBar, injecting the current selected page and navigation handler.
